families.Body: Pairs `key=value` separated by one space. A text value is quoted as in JSON
families.Printed by: `supervise`; with `relaunch.owner: root` the compatibility projection of the root's events

families.Label: `LOOP`
families.Body: Pairs `key=value` separated by one space. With the layer on: `strategy`, `level`, `containment`, `protection`, `units`, `pass`, `fail`, `unchecked`, `tainted`, `cycles`, `disengaged`, `escalations`, `failfast-stops`, `fallback`. The value of `protection` is `prevent`, `detect`, or `detect,basic` where only the basic protection holds. With the layer off: `strategy=classic reason=<reason>`. Only with parallel units on, also: `parallel`, `workers`, `groups`, `group-failures`, `refused`, `worker-caches`, `wall-hours`, `agent-hours`, and the fallback reason

supervisorLines.Keys: `next`, or `poll-in`; after a retrospective, the free text `suggestion (not run): <command>` in place of the pairs
`pipeline`, `sent`, and further keys of the owner

Per stage: `pipeline`, `stage`, `status`, `detail`, `path`; when no stage can be read: `status`, `reason`, and `pipeline` and `path` where known; a copied evaluation line: the label, three spaces, and the line as `learn` printed it

productLines.Keys: `action`, `feature`, `approvals`, and where the command has one, `out` or `from`
